title: IndexError: list index out of range in get_last_element
body:
## Bug Description

The `get_last_element` function has an off-by-one error causing IndexError.

## Error Message

```
IndexError: list index out of range
```

## Stack Trace

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "src/list_utils.py", line 22, in get_last_element
    return items[len(items)]
IndexError: list index out of range
```

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Call `get_last_element([1, 2, 3])`
2. Function tries to access `items[len(items)]` which is `items[3]`
3. Valid indices are 0-2, so IndexError is raised

## Expected Behavior

Should return the last element (3) without error.

## Actual Behavior

Raises IndexError due to off-by-one error.

## Additional Context

The correct index for the last element should be `len(items) - 1`.
